sections.h2: One BSS for prepaid and postpaid

blocks.text: Charging and policy in real time, Wi-Fi where radio coverage ends, and one **BSS for mobile operators** that handles prepaid and postpaid.
You can take Alepo from the core to the customer, or one product at a time, beside other vendors' cores and the systems you already run.
For: Mobile operators with prepaid or postpaid subscribers, or both
Marketing launches bundles without a code release. Data plans are built in the Policy Control portal, and bundles change in Online Charging by configuration.
Products: Policy Control · Online Charging

sections.h2: Subscribers stay connected where radio ends

blocks.text: Where radio coverage ends, subscribers move to Wi-Fi automatically with their SIM. Data and calls continue on the same AAA and the same usage record.
Wi-Fi Offload and Calling

sections.h2: No usage record lost before the bill run

blocks.text: Every usage record is accounted for before the bill run. Mediation Studio keeps a balancing ledger per file, showing what the network sent and what billing received. Duplicates and gaps are found before the bill run.
Mediation Studio

AI Agent Assist (beta) answers care agents' questions about bills and connections from live data. The AI Customer Assistant answers subscribers on web and app around the clock. It completes account tasks through the BSS inside the signed-in customer's own account, and hands complex cases to people.

items.q: Can one BSS handle prepaid and postpaid?
items.a: Yes. Digital BSS and Online Charging run **prepaid, postpaid** and hybrid plans on one system.

items.q: Does it work with our existing core network?
items.a: Yes. Each product runs beside other vendors' cores over standard interfaces such as Diameter.

items.q: Can we replace our BSS in stages?
items.a: Yes. Digital BSS is modular, so you can take it one module at a time.
